title: Uniform census-free envelope on the window [50508, 301994)
statement: Itinerary identity: for every L, the budgeted hug itinerary at (L, o_min) equals the exact IET L-prefix — the exact rule keeps u in [0, 1+alpha), so the prefix uses exactly o_min = ceil(L x) odds, and a first budget-forced divergence would make the exact prefix use more of one letter than its own total, a contradiction. Uniform envelope: greedy Ostrowski digits obey b_j <= a_{j+1}, so with the certified partial quotients of theta the digit sum on [50508, 301994) is at most 47 (exact scan max 37); the deficit keeps ln n' >= 17.07, so 2 s(L)/L <= 94/50508 = 1.87e-3 < 0.00514 <= J-gap, and by the DK/Ostrowski theorem C_L <= C_* + 2 s(L)/L < 1/(ln 3 ln n') for the hug itinerary of every window length, census-free.
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / discrepancy of irrational rotations
tested_range: all 251486 lengths in [50508, 301994) at floor 26254995: greedy digits within caps at every level (level 1054 reaches its cap 23), exact max digit sum 37 at L = 275632, worst 2s/L over J-gap 0.1823 at L = 74654 (uniform margin >= 5.48); integer-exact word-identity spot checks at 60000, 123456, 250000, 301993 beyond the 19 leftovers
notes: Discharges the crude-envelope caveat 'not a theorem for every L >= 50508' on the window and retires the per-row word-identity verification of juggler_walk_dk_envelope (now a theorem for all L). Envelope only: no new kills are claimed — kills still need the per-length finance comparison theta > (6/5) B guard, and near-convergents such as L = 176251 still survive. Uniform B/theta < 1 at a fixed floor stays false. Period bound unchanged. Not a halt theorem.
